shortDescription: Vary on or off target device

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: device_list
options.description: The name of the device. If the one of the device is IASP device, the become_user and become_user_password will be ignored.

options.name: extra_parameters
options.description: Extra parameter is appended at the end of VARYCFG command.

options.name: joblog
options.description: If set to C(true), append JOBLOG to stderr/stderr_lines.

options.name: status
options.description: C(on)/C(off) are idempotent actions that will not run commands unless necessary. C(reset) will always bounce the service. B(At least one of status are required.)
